get.description:
Return a list of all BIM File Extractions
A BIM File Extraction can fail for several reasons. When it does, the errors attribute contains a list of errors encountered while processing the model. The following table lists the possible error codes and types.

#### Error Types

| Code | Type                   |
|------|------------------------|
| 1    | Undefined              |
| 2    | NetworkErr             |
| 3    | ServerErr              |
| 4    | JsonParseErr           |
| 5    | TokenExpiredErr        |
| 6    | FileOpenErr            |
| 7    | FileWriteErr           |
| 8    | FileCompressionErr     |
| 9    | FileUploadError        |
| 10   | ModelReadErr           |
| 11   | ModelFileSizeErr       |
| 12   | ModelExportErr         |
| 13   | ModelEmptyDBErr        |
| 14   | ModelViewpointErr      |
| 15   | ModelErr               |
| 16   | InvalidStatusError     |
| 17   | FileDecompressionErr   |
| 18   | UnsupportedFileFormat  |
| 19   | No3DGeometry           |
| 20   | InvalidInputError      |
| 21   | UnsupportedFileSource  |
| 22   | MeshNodeLimitError     |
| 23   | RateLimitExhausted     |
| 24   | ODAGenericError        |
| 25   | FileUploadFasError     |

import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.0/bim_file_extractions?project_id=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&per_page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&filters%5Bid%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Bstatus%5D=SOME_STRING_VALUE&filters%5Bextraction_format%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Bbim_file_id%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Bbim_file_upload_id%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Bfile_version_id%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Bdocument_upload_id%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Bdocument_revision_id%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE")

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

x-changelog.description: A bim_file_upload object contains details of the associated BimFileUpload
The extraction_format_requests is an array that contains the details of extraction formats requested
Added a filter that allows BIM File Extractions to be filtered by file_version_id of a document associated to the extraction. The file_version_id can be matched on the bim_file_upload attribute
Added a filter that allows BIM File Extractions to be filtered by document_upload_id of a document associated to the extraction. The document_upload_id can be matched on the bim_file_upload attribute

x-changelog.summary: Added a new attribute manifest_file to API response
x-changelog.description: An item in the extraction_items array of item_type 'Properties' includes manifest_file attribute. Each file attribute contains a new size attribute
Added a filter query parameter that allows BIM File Extractions to be filtered by the type of extraction performed by the resource.
Added viewpoint_id to response body. viewpoint_id is the reference for BimViewpoint (resource for viewpoint)

x-changelog.summary: Removed conditioning_parameters which contain bounding_box from the response body
x-changelog.description: Removed conditioning_parameters to extend current BIM Viewpoint resource in order to support object selection, coloring and visibility settings

x-changelog.summary: Added bim_file_upload_id and bim_file_id filter parameters
x-changelog.description: Added filters that allows BIM File Extractions to be filtered by bim_file_upload_id and bim_file_id of a BIM File Upload associated to the extraction
Added a filter that allows BIM File Extractions to be filtered by document_revision_id of a document associated to the extraction. The document_revision_id is matched on the bim_file_upload attribute
